tgbroadcast.admin.title: Telegram broadcast
tgbroadcast.admin.intro: Write a message to post on our Telegram channels, to send to race-alert followers directly, or both. Plain text: line breaks are kept and nothing is formatted. Nothing is sent until you type SEND and press Send broadcast.
tgbroadcast.admin.target-channels: Post to our Telegram channels, each language to its own channel
tgbroadcast.admin.target-followers: Also message race-alert followers directly, each in their language, paced, once per broadcast
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-confirm: Type SEND in the box to confirm.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-target: Choose where to send it: our channels, followers, or both.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-not-live: Our Telegram channels are not live, so nothing can be posted there.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-followers: No race-alert followers are linked to Telegram, so there is nobody to message.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-en: Write the message. Press Enter for a new line.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-other: Optional. Leave empty and {lang} readers get the English message.
tgbroadcast.admin.chars-over: Too long for one Telegram message.
tgbroadcast.admin.en-required: English is required. Any language left empty gets the English message.
tgbroadcast.admin.empty-fallback: Empty: {lang} readers get the English message.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-none: No broadcast sent from the console yet.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-running: Sending: {posted} channel posts, {sent} of {audience} direct messages sent, {failed} failed. You can close this page; the server keeps going.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-done: Last broadcast finished: {posted} channel posts, {sent} of {audience} direct messages sent, {failed} failed.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-interrupted: Last broadcast stopped because the server restarted: {delivered} direct messages delivered, {waiting} still waiting. Resume it to reach the rest. Nobody gets it twice.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-failed: Last broadcast stopped with an error ({error}). {waiting} still waiting.
tgbroadcast.admin.preview-empty: Type the English message to see what each reader gets.
tgbroadcast.admin.no-own-channel: No channel of its own, so nothing is posted for this language.
tgbroadcast.admin.followers-get: {n} followers get it as a direct message
tgbroadcast.admin.waiting-note: {waiting} followers have not had it (for example, people who blocked the bot, or who followed since). Resume retries only them.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-sent: This message was already sent. Check the last broadcast below; type SEND again only if you mean to send it twice.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-nothing: Nothing is left to send for that broadcast.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-not-found: That broadcast was not found. Refresh.
tgbroadcast.admin.started: Started: {posts} channel posts and {dms} direct messages.
tgbroadcast.admin.resumed: Resumed: {posts} channel posts and {dms} direct messages.
tgnotice.admin.reason-not-live: Channel alerts are not live, so the notice cannot be sent.
tgnotice.admin.reason-nobody: Nobody is waiting for this notice.
